messages.subject: Error deploying shinyapps
parts:
facing issues while deploying shinyapps. The error is with the "rattle" package which is required by the function fancyRpartPlot used in the server.R module..
While building package, rattle uses "RGtk2' - which fails issuing the following

nlopt-2.4.2/stogo/testfun.h nlopt-2.4.2/stogo/gl################################# End Task Log ################################# Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 64054389 failed: Error building image: Error building RGtk2 (2.20.31). Build exited with non-zero status: 1


Request your help !!
